effect.notes: ACKS RAW (acore_spell_catalog_k-w_summary.xml: 240' range, 6 turns, invisible magical eye). Eye has infravision; otherwise sees as caster (including detect magic, see invisible, detect evil if those affect caster). Created anywhere caster can see within 240'. Moves 40' per round, directed by caster. Tether: never more than 240' from caster. Cannot pass solid objects but passes openings â‰¥1" diameter. Caster must concentrate to use the eye (concentration_mode=continuous_focus per duration_model). Apply_flag wizard_eye_active carries metadata for the scry subsystem; query_game_state surfaces a structured perception result. Eye-position rendering is the scry subsystem's job (parallel to Detect Magic / Clairaudience).

summary: Magically locks a door, chest, or portal; can only be opened by the caster, knock, or dispel magic.

effect.notes: ACKS RAW (acore_spell_catalog_k-w_summary.xml: 10' range, permanent; magically locks target door/chest/portal; original caster passes freely without affecting it; arcane spellcasters 3+ levels higher than wizard-lock caster also pass freely; otherwise opened only by physical break-in or successful dispel magic or knock (knock suspends for 1 turn, doesn't remove). Session 6 wires the open_close_lock step kind with operation=lock_magical and lock_metadata describing the gate rules. Dungeon door subsystem reads the active_effect to gate Pick Lock attempts and apply free-pass rules to the original caster.
